CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_deposit_settlement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_exit_date date;
  v_status    text;
  v_total_ded numeric;
BEGIN
  v_total_ded := COALESCE(NEW.pending_rent, 0)
               + COALESCE(NEW.pending_eb, 0)
               + COALESCE(NEW.pending_late_fees, 0)
               + COALESCE(NEW.damages, 0)
               + COALESCE(NEW.other_deductions, 0);

  IF v_total_ded <= 0 THEN
    RETURN NEW;   -- pure transfer / refund-only row: always allowed
  END IF;

  IF NEW.allotment_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;   -- legacy tenant-only settlement: keep prior behaviour
  END IF;

  SELECT staying_status::text, actual_exit_date
    INTO v_status, v_exit_date
    FROM public.tenant_allotments
   WHERE id = NEW.allotment_id;

  -- Block ONLY the obviously wrong case: deductions on an allotment that
  -- has neither an actual_exit_date nor an Exited / Cancelled status.
  IF v_exit_date IS NULL
     AND COALESCE(v_status, '') NOT IN ('Exited', 'Cancelled') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'deposit_settlements: cannot record ₹% in deductions on allotment % (status=%, actual_exit_date IS NULL). The tenant must have exited (or the row must be a deduction-free transfer settlement).',
      v_total_ded, NEW.allotment_id, COALESCE(v_status, 'unknown')
      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation',
            HINT = 'If you intended to record a deposit transfer, leave all deduction fields at zero.';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
